body:
Worker and reviewer rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-24, from w-56f386fdd7d3 round 9, a Codex High that Opus3 confirmed).

Test fixtures that fake test-launcher results must use the launcher's real shape. scripts/test-launcher.mjs (around line 1907) sets input.eligible = (outcome clean && state passed && sourceMatches). So every FAILED run carries eligible:false.

What went wrong: a fixture hardcoded eligible:true for failed runs. The product path called registered_closing_clean_input, which requires eligible == Some(true), and it silently dropped the settlement notice for every real failed run. All the failed-run tests still passed, across 8 review rounds.

Rules:
- Derive fixture fields from the launcher's own rule, never hand-pick them.
- When a fix changes a fixture to the real shape, name in the READY packet one test that was watched failing without the fix.
- Reviewers: when a test passes on the "failed" path, check the fixture's eligible, outcome and state against the launcher.
